name: straight arms backward chest stretch
description: Reaching straight arms backward opens your chest and the front of your shoulders. Simple, quick and good between sets or after a desk session.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
